title: Fun tour and you'll learn a lot.
text: Aaron was a great guide and this was a great tour. Lots of dark history and stories that were very interesting. I had no idea the Inquisition lasted so long! We also dud a " post tour" tour of Cada Batllo and some Gaudi houses walking by them as a "happy wrap up" to lightem the dark mood. Highly recommend!
author: Bob_F

title: Great experience and highly recommended.
text: The tour was great! Aaron (sp?) Our guide was wonderful and knowledgeable and had a great sense of humor. Who knew there were so many dark stories about this place? Or that the Inquisition was around so long? Or that the gruesome execution methods were last used in 1974? Not me! We also did a "post tour" tour of some of the Gaudi architecture which was excellent to raise the datk mood a bit. Highly recommend this tour!

title: Awesome experience!
text: Our ghosts of the past walking tour was awesome. Katerina was a wonderful guide — smart, informative and easy to follow. She’s a great storyteller who made the experience fun and interesting. It piqued our personal interests and curiosity around things both dark and that of the history of liberatory struggles in Barcelona. If you’re interested hearing more about historical events like the Spanish civil war and the witch trials, this is a great way to find out. This city has secrets if you know where to look!
